value.title: The Two Heroes: End-Roll BBQ Picture Drama
value.synopsis: It's the day after the incident at I-Island, Deku & All Might discuss the future of David & Melissa. On the other hand, All Might's has planned a BBQ for all the members of Class 1A.

value.title: You're Next - Movie Etiquette Class
value.synopsis: It features comical interactions that make use of the usual characters, such as Bakugo getting angry over a phone call during the screening between the current No.1 hero Endeavor and his son Shoto, and Deku getting flustered when Bakugo starts eating snacks!
